params.body:
The workbench runs several agents at once. On 7 October 2026 a Gradle build beside them helped bring it down.

This adds one rule to the workspace CLAUDE.md: a heavy job (a Gradle or Android build, a full test suite, `npm ci`, `composer install`) asks for its memory first, through `agents.mjs run --mb <MB> -- <command>` (portal-cli, separate PR).

- No `-Xmx` of the agent's own for Gradle: `~/.gradle/gradle.properties` is the boundary.
- During work, run the tests a change touches; the full suite once, before the proposal.
